modernity.evidence: Rounded green hero panel, soft cards and bold sans-serif type; clean contemporary style.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Headline and yellow button lead the hero; class schedule cards follow in a clear row.

mobile_usability.evidence: Single-column hero with a full-width button and two-column class cards; menu links are hidden.

readability.evidence: White on deep green and dark text on pale green are both clear; schedule labels are small.

imagery_quality.evidence: Hero art is a simple figure drawing over circles; illustrative, with no studio photography.

trust_signals.evidence: Star rating with 180 reviews and "Teaching since 2016" appear only in a small line near the bottom.

cta_clarity.evidence: Yellow "Book your first class — €15" button stands out against the dark green panel.

brand_consistency.evidence: Green and yellow palette from the logo dot repeats across the hero, cards and stars.

summary.en: Modern, friendly yoga studio page with a clear first-class offer and visible schedule. Trust signals are present but small.
summary.fr: Page de studio de yoga moderne et accueillante, avec une offre de premier cours claire et un planning visible. Les éléments de confiance sont présents mais discrets.
